title: Q2
description:
“Moses also was faithful in all His house.”
Read: Num 12:1–8
a) In Num 12 Yahweh defends Moses against Miriam and Aaron. Moses is His servant, spoken to “face to face.” What does that setting bring forward when Hebrews ranks the Son even above Moses: the Son *over* the house, Moses a servant *in* it?
